SELECT id, student_id AS studentId, homework_id AS homeworkId, question_id AS questionId, question_content AS questionContent, explain_content AS explainContent, create_time AS createTime FROM student_favorite WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
